# Minamol Tablets: Package Leaflet

Note: this document is a sample for testing. Minamol Tablets is a fictional product, and nothing here is dosing advice for any real medicine.

## 1 About the product

Minamol Tablets is an over-the-counter oral medicine that relieves headache and fever.

- Contents: 24 tablets
- Weight of one tablet: 250 mg

The weight of one tablet is 0.25 g.

## 2 How to take

Take the amount in the table below with water.

| Age | Dose | Times a day |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 15 and over | 2 tablets | 3 |
| 12 to 14 | 1 tablet | 3 |
| 7 to 11 | half a tablet | 3 |
| Under 7 | do not take | - |

From age 15, take 2 tablets at a time, up to 3 times a day. The maximum daily dose is 6 tablets.

Leave at least 4 hours between doses, and do not take more than 3 doses a day.

## 3 Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount in 3 tablets |
| --- | --- |
| Minamorin | 300 mg |
| Seiranic acid | 60 mg |
| Amber herb extract | 75 mg |
| Total | 435 mg |

## 4 Do not

Do not drive or operate machinery after taking Minamol Tablets.
